t: You're standing at the memorial to Dame Louisa Aldrich-Blake, in Tavistock Square Gardens. She was the first woman to receive the degree of Master of Surgery. She worked at the New Hospital for Women and Children and the Royal Free Hospital, and she was dean of the London School of Medicine for Women. She pioneered surgical treatment for cervical and colorectal cancer. The memorial is bronze and stone, designed by Sir Edwin Lutyens, with the sculpture by Arthur George Walker.
